subject: Approval request: open two Inference/Runtime SRE hires (low-latency lane)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval request: open two Inference/Runtime SRE hires (low-latency lane)

Hi Rishi and Jonas,

Requesting approval to post and recruit for two permanent engineering roles on the Runtime/Inference team focused on low-latency production infra. This is time-sensitive: customer SLAs and an upcoming product rollout mean we need hires in Q4. Summary: 

- Roles requested (2 headcount):
  1) Senior Inference SRE (IC6) — focus: inference runtime ops, KV cache reliability, incident ownership
  2) Staff Inference Engineer (IC7) — focus: kernel/pathway optimizations, throughput/latency regressions, cross-team rollouts

- Justification:
  • Persistent latency SLO regressions on long-tailed sequences during peak that current on-call rotations can't cover.
  • We plan to offload recurring troubleshooting (KV fragmentation, cold-starts) to these hires to free senior team for optimizations.
  • Risk: if we miss Q4 performance targets, we lose 2 potential enterprise expansions.

- Proposed comp bands (based on comp-bands-q3-2026):
  • IC6: base $185k–$235k, target OTE (incl. equity) $220k
  • IC7: base $250k–$320k, target OTE $300k

- Timeline: post this week, interviews in 4–6 weeks, offers late Oct. Start target: Dec/Jan.

Attachments: role packet + recommended offer template + band CSV (attached).

Please confirm approval to open both reqs and the top-of-band guidance for IC7. If you want to route to Finance first, advise and I’ll loop Lauren.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Platform Recruiting (on behalf of Runtime Staffing)
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs:
- 2026-09-04-inference-sre-role-packet.pdf (JD, hiring manager notes)
- comp-bands-q3-2026.csv (internal band reference)
- offer-template-inference.docx (HR-approved template)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: open two Inference/Runtime SRE hires (low-latency lane)

Thanks Steph — important ask. A couple of quick clarifying items before I sign off: 

1) Can you add expected ramp timeline and the concrete impact metrics we plan to own (e.g., p99 under 100 ms for 8k seq, reduced incident MTTR by 40%)? I want measurable goals in the req.
2) For IC7 top-of-band: can we cap comp at $310k unless we get explicit exec exception? We should try to keep comp predictable for forecasting.
3) Do we have any internal candidates or contractors we can convert to soften headcount impact? If we can convert one contractor, we can fast-track delivery.

If those items are addressed I’m prepared to greenlight the reqs — pending Lauren’s budget confirmation.

-Rishi
VP, Inference Engineering

Subject: Re: Approval request: open two Inference/Runtime SRE hires (low-latency lane)

Adding the context Rishi asked for. Stephanie, I updated the role packet with measurable objectives and a 90/180 day ramp plan; see attached. Key points: 

- 90-day goals (IC6): ownership of on-call rotation, implement persistent KV cache monitoring, triage major incidents within SLA windows.
- 180-day goals (IC7): land two kernel-level optimizations with quantifiable throughput improvements (>=15% tokens/sec improvement on 2 benchmark models), reduce cold-start median by 30%.

- Contractor conversion: We have a .6 FTE contractor (ops contractor) who could be converted to IC6 quickly; that would reduce new reqs to 1 net new hire. However, converting requires committee sign-off and would still count against headcount unless we reclassify.

- Cost of delay: conservative estimate — $120k ARR at risk per enterprise account impacted by latency regressions in next two quarters.

Attachments: updated role packet (inline notes) and short slide on metrics.

Jonas
Director, Platform Runtime

On Fri, Sep 4, 2026 at 1:45 PM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> [Rishi's clarifying questions]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Recruiting Ops <recruiting-ops@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: open two Inference/Runtime SRE hires (low-latency lane)

Thanks for the detail. Finance has reviewed and will approve the headcount with the following constraints: 

1) Budget code: ENG-PLAT-Q4. We can fund two FTEs, but top-of-band for IC7 is constrained to $305,000 base without an exec-level compensation exception. Please use $305k as the planning cap.
2) Request that we prioritize converting the existing .6 contractor to full-time IC6 where possible — that reduces recruit load and budget draw for Q4. If converted, Finance will re-allocate remaining budget to a single new IC7 hire.
3) Please attach the recruiting plan (SLA to close, target interview panel, and expected offer levers). We need the hire to be in payroll before 2027-01-31 to be in this fiscal plan.

I approve the reqs conditional on the above. Loop HR (Recruiting Ops) to start paperwork and create HR-1427.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Finance — Engineering Spend
